newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Belfox broker FIMAT moves ops to London.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Belfox broker FIMAT moves ops to London.

text.p: Societe Generale subsidiary FIMAT, one of the world's leading futures brokers, has moved its membership of the Belgian Futures and Options Exchange (BELFOX) from its Luxembourg to London unit, BELFOX said on Tuesday.

"BELFOX is pleased with this decision as it not only gives further shape to BELFOX's strategy to expand its membership over Europe and, especially, the United Kingdom but also demonstrates the confidence and commitment of an international and well established brokerage and financial group towards BELFOX," it said in a statement. The move took place on Monday August 2.
